title: MOD of negative operands takes the sign of the dividend
note: IEC 61131-3 IN1 MOD IN2 = IN1 - (IN1 / IN2) * IN2 with the division truncated toward zero: the remainder has the sign of IN1, so -7 MOD 3 = -1, 7 MOD -3 = 1, -7 MOD -3 = -1 and -2147483647 MOD 10 = -7 (the function form MOD(x, y) is not parsed yet: parser.ts)
